activity.notes: After joining Scipio and helping defeat and capture Syphax in 203 BCE, Masinissa recovered effective royal authority over the Massylii. By about 202 BCE the Roman-backed settlement and annexation of Syphax's territories produced the wider unified Numidian kingdom already represented by his existing c.202-148 BCE Activity. ATLAS records this restored Massylian phase separately from both his earlier interrupted reign and the subsequent Kingdom of Numidia.

sources.title: Masinissa — Oxford Classical Dictionary
sources.citation_text: Oxford describes Masinissa's renewed fortunes with Scipio, the defeat and capture of Syphax, and the recovery of his kingship before the final Numidian settlement.

sources.title: Masinissa — Encyclopedia of Ancient History
sources.citation_text: The scholarly reference describes the Roman grant of Syphax's lands and royal confirmation that culminated in Masinissa's unified Numidian kingship.
